scope: Proposal for the Q12 measured feedback text height repair; not implementation or full acceptance.

fit.reason: Directly addresses reproduced native clipping while preserving authored explanation and accessibility cap.

simplicity.reason: One local measured text implementation shared by the two related Details body paths; no global wrapper or SDK patch.

risk.reason: Small one-pixel adjustment with keyed resets and one-time guard; native confirmation of the smaller margin remains required.

maintainability.reason: Pixel-rounding/lifecycle behavior can be tested locally and remains owned by the existing feedback component.

evidenceAssessment.nativeSource: Installed React Native iOS RCTTextShadowView sets NSLineBreakByClipping when maximumNumberOfLines is unset; this is consistent with, but does not alone prove, the observed failure mechanism.

designAssessment.approach: Local measured FeedbackText for authored messages and detailLines. On first onLayout, ceil(height * scale) / scale + one physical pixel; ignore later layout callbacks; use a React key with text, width, fontScale and physical scale to reset measurement.
implementationNotes: Append the measurement signature to each existing sibling identity/index in the React key, so duplicate strings cannot collide.
Treat onLayout as the initial measured frame, not an intrinsic-content-size API.
Test pixel rounding, one-time capture/no growth loop, and reset when text or size geometry changes.
Confirm the exact one-physical-pixel margin natively at supported maximum text in both themes and at ordinary Large; the prior +1pt probe is not proof of the smaller margin.

limits: Design review only; no implementation has been checked.
The temporary +1pt screenshot supports height sensitivity but does not prove the proposed +1 physical pixel margin until native checks run.
No Q12, full BIZQ-01, VoiceOver, Premium or release acceptance is claimed.
